items.title: Meraas and BGRE launch a new Solaya phase in Jumeirah 1
items.summary: A limited collection of 2- to 5-bedroom residences, including four-bedroom duplexes and a penthouse, in the beachfront Solaya community (234 residences across nine buildings in total).

items.title: Meraas unveils 97 villas at Nad Al Sheba Gardens
items.summary: 97 four- and five-bedroom villas (55 four-bedroom, 42 five-bedroom) on the northern edge of the community, with a private school planned on its north-western boundary.

items.project: Al Maryah Island branded residences (ALAIN partnership, first of five)
items.title: ALAIN and Emaar Hospitality open AED 8bn Abu Dhabi pipeline with Al Maryah Island project
items.summary: First of five branded Address, Palace and Vida residential projects (AED 8bn combined): 452 apartments and penthouses on Al Maryah Island, with one-bedroom homes from AED 3.7m and sales stated to start soon.

items.title: Sobha launches The Mirage at Sobha Central
items.summary: New tower of 677 apartments in the Sobha Central mixed-use masterplan on Sheikh Zayed Road, launched after the earlier towers there sold over 1,500 units (AED 3.5bn).

items.title: Nakheel publishes Palm Springs starting prices
items.summary: Official starting price of AED 3.8m for the Palm Springs townhouses and villas, with handover stated as October 2030.

items.title: Shahrukhz Residences penthouses sold out
items.summary: All penthouses at Shahrukhz Residences by Danube have sold out; each was designed by Gauri Khan and valued at AED 19.6m.

items.title: Alef officially launches Linar; Phase I bids fully reserved
items.summary: Official launch of the AED 4bn Linar waterfront project in Al Mamzar: 2,620 units across five residential towers, with Phase I bids (1,572 units across Towers A to C) fully reserved.
